# CASTLE INVADERS - D.A. Trabucco - DREAMER 11 p.17 (PDF page 19) - CHIP-8 0080-03FF (printed 0080-0400)
# run C000 (FN 3); 1K. Space Invaders style: man the cannon, shoot 'Invaders' (5 points) and
# 'Commanders' (15 points) with 30 bombs. The game ends when the bombs run out, the invaders
# infiltrate the castle or the cannon is hit by an invader's bomb. Score shown at the end (0080);
# any key restarts.
# keys (printed): 8 left (0262 6108), A right (0258 610A), 9 fire (0272 6109).
# The scanned copy carries a reader's handwritten key remap, NOT applied: text "8"->C, "A"->1(?),
# "9" crossed out; listing 0259 0A->01, 0263 08->00, 0273 09->05. Printed values kept.
# Other hand marks (circles around 03A8 03E8, 03C6 CE01, 03E4 03C6, 03E8 F600) only highlight the
# machine-code parts: 03C6 LDX #01C0 / LDAA #00 / JMP C07D; 03E8 LDAB 003A / STAB 21 / LDAB #40 /
# JMP C2E5 (CHIPOS tone). 00AA-00DF is not printed (filled with 00; 00C0 = BCD score).
